brief.headline: Revenue fell 10.3% to 43042 while sessions rose 11.9% to 31088, and the biggest funnel leak was Add to cart -> checkout.
executive_summary: Sessions were 31088, up 11.9%, and conversion rate was 1.9, up 2.4%.
Cart to checkout rate was 54.18, down 47.3% from 102.82.
Product view to cart rate was 33.65, up 76.1%, but the figure must be verified before acting.

what_changed.title: Total revenue declined while traffic increased
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 43042, down 10.3% from 47973. Sessions were 31088, up 11.9% from 27780. Revenue per session was 1.38, down 19.8% from 1.73.

what_changed.title: Product view to cart rate rose, but tracking must be verified
what_changed.detail: Product view to cart rate was 33.65, up 76.1% from 19.11. check_tracking is true, so the figure must be verified before acting.

what_changed.title: Cart to checkout step weakened
what_changed.detail: Cart to checkout rate was 54.18, down 47.3% from 102.82. The anomaly has segment_revenue_delta -4931.

what_changed.title: Organic revenue per session underperformed total
what_changed.detail: (organic) campaign revenue per session was 1.23, down 36.6% from 1.94. gap_vs_total_pts was -16.7.

what_changed.title: Canada revenue moved differently from total
what_changed.detail: Canada revenue was 4561, up 53.7% from 2968. gap_vs_total_pts was 64.

likely_drivers: The previous week included US Thanksgiving and Black Friday, while this week included Cyber Monday, so the revenue decline is likely consistent with post-Black Friday seasonality.
The funnel shows the main change in Add to cart -> checkout, so the revenue decline is likely consistent with a checkout-step issue rather than a traffic issue.
Organic revenue per session moved more negatively than total, so the organic mix is likely consistent with lower revenue per session.
risks: If the Add to cart -> checkout leak is not addressed, the total anomaly has segment_revenue_delta -4931.
If product view to cart tracking is not verified, actions may be based on a figure that is not a demand story.
If organic revenue per session is not reviewed, the gap_vs_total_pts of -16.7 remains a watch item.
